AbstentionBreakdown.description: Abstention rate per reason, over the same denominator as coverage.
AbstentionBreakdown.title: AbstentionBreakdown

AnswerInteraction.description: What the client declares. The server derives `EntryMode` from it.
AnswerInteraction.title: AnswerInteraction

AnswerSubmission.description: What a client may declare. The server derives `entry_mode` from it.
AnswerSubmission.title: AnswerSubmission

AuthoringBuildManifest.description:
Everything that could change a retrieval result, fixed and hashed.

`lexical_only` is a declared mode, not a silent degradation: no model is ever
downloaded to make a hybrid build succeed.
AuthoringBuildManifest.title: AuthoringBuildManifest

AuthoringRequest.description: Persisted intent. Its scenario payload stays encrypted inside the clinic.
AuthoringRequest.title: AuthoringRequest

AuthoringRequestIntent.description: What the pure runtime returns for an uncovered scenario. It writes nothing.
AuthoringRequestIntent.title: AuthoringRequestIntent

AuthoringReview.description: Authoring review is a different entity from a case review.
AuthoringReview.title: AuthoringReview

ChallengerTrainingProtocolVersion.description: Optimiser settings fixed before a run, not per-run flags.
ChallengerTrainingProtocolVersion.title: ChallengerTrainingProtocolVersion

CorpusVersion.description: The exact set of document versions a catalogue was built from.
CorpusVersion.title: CorpusVersion

DataQuality.description: DQI describes quality; it is never a predictive feature or a gate.
DataQuality.title: DataQuality

DatasetSnapshot.description: Immutable, hashed, and separated by origin. Real and synthetic never mix.
DatasetSnapshot.title: DatasetSnapshot

DefaultPresentation.description:
Proof that a suggestion was shown for this field in this session.

Its existence is what makes any other value for that field `default_edited`,
however the client labels it (rule 7).
DefaultPresentation.title: DefaultPresentation

DefaultSuggestion.description: Stateless default shown by the form plan.
DefaultSuggestion.title: DefaultSuggestion

DocumentChunk.description: A citation without a verifiable locator cannot be published.
DocumentChunk.title: DocumentChunk

DocumentVersion.description: Without version, rights and hashes a document is not indexed.
DocumentVersion.title: DocumentVersion

EntryMode.description: Derived by the server, never sent by a browser.
EntryMode.title: EntryMode

EpisodeRole.description: v0.3 creates exactly one role. Baseline and evaluation use only this one.
EpisodeRole.title: EpisodeRole

ErrorCode.description:
Stable machine codes for the error envelope.

`forbidden` covers cross-tenant and same-tenant-without-grant alike: telling
the caller which one it was would confirm that a subject exists somewhere
else. Both are audited.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

ErrorDetail.description: Stable machine code plus sanitised Spanish copy.
ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

EstimateKind.description: What the number means, so a track cannot borrow another track's meaning.
EstimateKind.title: EstimateKind

EvaluationProtocolVersion.description: Splits, seeds, interval method and estimability rules, all versioned.
EvaluationProtocolVersion.title: EvaluationProtocolVersion

EvaluationReport.description: One report, one exact target definition version. No pooling in v0.3.
EvaluationReport.title: EvaluationReport

FeatureSnapshot.description:
The closed instant a prediction was made from.

It stores the exact projected IDs so it is never recomputed, and it refuses
to mix origins: one synthetic row invalidates a real snapshot.
FeatureSnapshot.title: FeatureSnapshot

FieldCode.description:
The 19 daily observation fields.

`major_dysregulation_24h` is absent on purpose: it is an outcome, not a
daily observation.
FieldCode.title: FieldCode

FieldObservation.description: One observed value, with the provenance that decides how it may be used.
FieldObservation.title: FieldObservation

FormQuestion.description: One field in the stateless plan.
FormQuestion.title: FormQuestion

FormSession.description:
`opened_at` fixes identity and audit policy; `submitted_at` is the cutoff.

The browser never decides either one.
FormSession.title: FormSession

FormSessionKind.description: A professional observation session shows no defaults.
FormSessionKind.title: FormSessionKind

GroupMetric.description: A per-group metric, suppressed unless the privacy minimums are met.
GroupMetric.title: GroupMetric

Interval.description: A closed probability interval. Both bounds or neither.
Interval.title: Interval

MetricStatus.description: A metric without support is `not_estimable`, never zero.
MetricStatus.title: MetricStatus

MetricValue.description: A number with its estimability, or an explicit reason there is none.
MetricValue.title: MetricValue

ModelVersion.description:
A trained artifact and the only states it is allowed to be in.

There is no automatic promotion to an operational champion in v0.3.
ModelVersion.title: ModelVersion

OutcomeAdjudication.description: An operational decision on a conflict. It does not restore eligibility.
OutcomeAdjudication.title: OutcomeAdjudication

OutcomeReport.description: One person's answer, kept forever even when it arrives too late.
OutcomeReport.title: OutcomeReport

OutcomeReportRequest.description: The client sends the answer only. Actor, role, timing and target are server-side.
OutcomeReportRequest.title: OutcomeReportRequest

OutcomeReportResponse.description: Report and resolution are returned separately; they are different facts.
OutcomeReportResponse.title: OutcomeReportResponse

OutcomeReportValue.description: A report is not a resolution.
OutcomeReportValue.title: OutcomeReportValue

OutcomeReportView.description: The wire view refuses exactly what `OutcomeReport` refuses.
OutcomeReportView.title: OutcomeReportView

OutcomeRequest.description: Immutable scheduling record. Its state is derived, never mutated.
OutcomeRequest.title: OutcomeRequest

OutcomeRequestState.description: Derived from the active resolution and the clock, never mutated.
OutcomeRequestState.title: OutcomeRequestState

OutcomeRequestView.description: One pending item of the actor's inbox, with its derived state.
OutcomeRequestView.title: OutcomeRequestView

OutcomeResolution.description: An append-only materialisation recomputed after every correction.
OutcomeResolution.title: OutcomeResolution

OutcomeResolutionView.description: A resolution is not a report, and a conflict never becomes clean again.
OutcomeResolutionView.title: OutcomeResolutionView

PosteriorDefault.description: The estimator output behind one suggestion.
PosteriorDefault.title: PosteriorDefault

PredictionAbstentionReason.description: Closed catalogue of why a track produced no visible estimate.
PredictionAbstentionReason.title: PredictionAbstentionReason

PredictionEpisode.description: An immutable opportunity with a 24-hour window and a 48-hour deadline.
PredictionEpisode.title: PredictionEpisode

PredictionEpisodeResponse.description: The authorised view of one episode: window, tracks and data quality.
PredictionEpisodeResponse.title: PredictionEpisodeResponse

PredictionOutput.description: One track's answer for one episode, including its abstention.
PredictionOutput.title: PredictionOutput

PredictionOutputView.description:
A single track's answer as a caller sees it.

`confidence` is absent on purpose: what a track publishes about its own
uncertainty is its interval, and a track without one says nothing rather
than borrowing another's.

The challenger appears here now. It used to be barred outright because it
ran in shadow; it is an operational track since it started answering the
24-hour question, and the bar came off with the intended use.
PredictionOutputView.title: PredictionOutputView

PredictionStatus.description: Abstention is a valid HTTP 200 outcome.
PredictionStatus.title: PredictionStatus

QuestionPresentation.description:
Proof that a field was highlighted, which is what "asked" means.

Appearing in the tail is not being asked and does not reset the clock.
QuestionPresentation.title: QuestionPresentation

QuestionReason.description: Why a field appears where it does in the plan (order).
QuestionReason.title: QuestionReason

RecommendationAbstentionReason.description: Derives exactly one reason, in this precedence order.
RecommendationAbstentionReason.title: RecommendationAbstentionReason

RecommendationDecisionRequest.description:
A professional's verdict on one drafted recommendation.

`approved` and `rejected` only. `RecommendationReview` in the domain also
admits substituting a human plan, deferring and declaring the item not
applicable; the live surface exposes the two that a reviewer can act on
without a strategy catalogue behind them, and adding a third here without
the machinery to honour it would be a button that lies.
RecommendationDecisionRequest.title: RecommendationDecisionRequest

RecommendationDecisionResponse.description: The review as stored. Append only: a change of mind is a new row.
RecommendationDecisionResponse.title: RecommendationDecisionResponse

ReleaseManifest.description:
Implementation, corpus, target and catalogue status, declared separately.

Without a legally usable corpus M4 and the DoD stay blocked; without an
authorised reviewer the catalogue can only be `blocked_clinical_review`
.
ReleaseManifest.title: ReleaseManifest

ReviewQueueResponse.description:
The sampled slice a professional is asked to review.

The response carries the draw that produced it —denominator and policy
version— because a queue that does not say it is a sample reads as the
whole workload, and a reviewer would conclude the other four fifths were
never drafted.
ReviewQueueResponse.title: ReviewQueueResponse

RuntimeDecision.description: The pure runtime answer: at most three strategies, or an abstention.
RuntimeDecision.title: RuntimeDecision

RuntimeStrategyMatch.description: One matched strategy in runtime order, with the citations of its version.
RuntimeStrategyMatch.title: RuntimeStrategyMatch

ScenarioBuildResult.description:
Outcome of the pure P1 `build_scenario` facade.

P2 persists this or the abstention; it never re-derives the precedence.
ScenarioBuildResult.title: ScenarioBuildResult

ScenarioV1.description:
The minimal matching payload. No identity, notes, external IDs or history.

Treated as potentially pseudonymised while a combination of attributes could
be linkable; it is never presumed anonymous.
ScenarioV1.title: ScenarioV1

Source.description:
Observation context, not the actor and not a bibliographic source.

`source_id` is reserved for corpus documents; `actor_id` records who
reported and `source_mapping_id` which adapter was used.
Source.title: Source

SourceMapping.description: A versioned adapter. Unknown source values fail; they never become null.
SourceMapping.title: SourceMapping

SourceMetric.description: Metrics broken down by observation context.
SourceMetric.title: SourceMetric

StrategyCitation.description: Links one claim to one literal fragment of one hashed chunk.
StrategyCitation.title: StrategyCitation

StrategyClaim.description: A claim is a span of the reviewed action text, with its own citations.
StrategyClaim.title: StrategyClaim

Subject.description: Cohort membership decides which tracks may ever see this subject.
Subject.title: Subject

SubjectProfile.description:
Only the attributes matching needs, from closed catalogues.

Tags are never inferred from free notes, and `care_mode` is a token from a
tenant-versioned catalogue that the contract does not enumerate.
SubjectProfile.title: SubjectProfile

SubmitStatus.description: Only `episode_created` creates a snapshot, outputs and an outcome request.
SubmitStatus.title: SubmitStatus

TargetDefinitionVersion.description:
The versioned question a real label answers.

An imported intensity label proves a category exists in an export; it does
not define how a new person should answer. Without an `active` version the
system accepts demo fixtures and abstains from creating real labels
.
TargetDefinitionVersion.title: TargetDefinitionVersion

TargetSelection.description: The single selectable definition at a cutoff, or why there is none.
TargetSelection.title: TargetSelection

TrainingRun.description: A run that produced a candidate, or an honest reason it produced none.
TrainingRun.title: TrainingRun

VoiEstimate.description:
Mutual information in nats, or an explicit reason it is unavailable.

Unavailable means `voi_nats=null`. Zero would claim the value was computed
and found uninformative.
VoiEstimate.title: VoiEstimate
